transcript:
# City of Malden

## Meeting Minutes - Final

## Rules & Ordinance Committee

*Councillor Winslow, Chair*
*Councillor Colon Hayes, Vice-Chair*
*Councillor Crowe*
*Councillor Linehan*
*Councillor O'Malley*

**Tuesday, May 5, 2026** | **5:30 PM** | **215 Pleasant Street, Room 105, Malden, MA 02148**

Watch the meeting with Teams: https://tinyurl.com/mst4ns6e

## Roll Call

Chair Winslow called the meeting to order at 5:36 PM.

Also in attendance was Nelson Miller, Ron Hogan, Zaheer Samee, and Councillor McDonald.

**Present:** 3 - Stephen Winslow, Karen Colon Hayes and Peg Crowe

**Absent:** 2 - Amanda Linehan and Ryan O'Malley

## Minutes to be Approved

**238-26** Minutes for the meeting of March 17, 2026

A motion was made by Councillor Colon Hayes, seconded by Councillor Crowe, that the Committee Minutes be approved. The motion carried by a unanimous vote.

## Business

**197-26** Be it ordained by the Malden City Council that the Code of the City of Malden (MCC) 6.08.070 C(2) LICENSING OF MARIJUANA ESTABLISHMENTS is hereby amended by inserting ', provided that no fewer than five marijuana retailer licenses shall be made available.' after 'Mass. Gen. Laws ch 138 § 15'.

**Sponsors:** Karen Colon Hayes

**Attachments:** Final Paper: 197-26

Councillor Colon Hayes explained the need to clarify the ordinance language for marijuana retail licenses, noting previous confusion when the number of liquor licenses fluctuated and the lack of clear notification procedures the for the subsequent fluctuation of marijuana retail licenses.

Mr. Hogan explained that the sections of marijuana retail licenses and liquor licenses in the ordinances conflicted, with one defining an initial licensing period and another setting a cap, resulting in inconsistent license numbers. This amendment would avoid future confusion and prevent inadvertent violations of the ordinance.

Mr. Hogan also explained the simplest solution would be to set a fixed cap of five marijuana retail licenses given that population increases required for additional licenses are unlikely.

A motion was made by Councillor Colon Hayes, seconded by Councillor Crowe, that the Ordinance be recommended favorably to the City Council. The motion carried by a unanimous vote.

## Adjournment

A motion was made by Councillor Crowe, seconded by Councillor Colon Hayes, that this meeting be adjourned. The motion carried unanimously.

Meeting adjourned at 5:43 PM.

headline: Recommended favorably to City Council an ordinance requiring no fewer than five marijuana retailer licenses, by unanimous vote.
summary: The committee discussed an ordinance amendment to MCC 6.08.070 C(2) that would require the city to make available no fewer than five marijuana retailer licenses. Councillor Colon Hayes and Mr. Hogan explained the change would resolve conflicts between marijuana retail and liquor licensing rules. The committee voted unanimously to recommend the ordinance favorably to the City Council.
decisions: Recommended favorably to the City Council an ordinance amendment to MCC 6.08.070 C(2) requiring no fewer than five marijuana retailer licenses, by unanimous vote.
